description.zh: 马丘比丘是印加帝国最著名的遗址，建于公元15世纪，位于海拔2,430米的安第斯山脊之上，四周云雾缭绕。1983年列入UNESCO世界遗产，被誉为「失落的印加城市」。
description.en: Machu Picchu is the Inca Empire's most celebrated site, built in the 15th century on a 2,430 m Andean ridge shrouded in cloud. A UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1983 — the original 'Lost City of the Incas'.

zh: 世界遗产
七大奇迹
印加文明
en: UNESCO
Wonder of World
Inca Civilisation

zh: 15世纪印加文明最完整的城市遗址，「失落的天空之城」
云雾环绕的安第斯山峰之间，壮观程度超乎想象
世界新七大奇迹，UNESCO世界遗产
en: Most complete Inca city ruin; the 'Lost City in the Clouds'
Cloud-wreathed Andean setting that exceeds all expectations
New Seven Wonders and UNESCO World Heritage Site

tips.zh: 门票必须提前在官网预约，每日限额；从库斯科乘火车到阿瓜斯卡连特斯（印加热水城）再转巴士是标准路线。
tips.en: Timed tickets must be booked well in advance on the official website — daily visitor numbers are strictly capped. Train from Cusco to Aguas Calientes, then bus up, is the standard route.

description.zh: 的的喀喀湖是世界上海拔最高的可通航湖泊，海拔3,812米，跨越秘鲁与玻利维亚边境。湖中的芦苇岛（乌鲁斯浮岛）是当地印第安人世代居住的独特水上社区。
description.en: Lake Titicaca at 3,812 m is the world's highest navigable lake, straddling the Peru-Bolivia border. The floating reed islands (Uros) are unique water communities inhabited for generations.

zh: 高原湖泊
浮岛
印第安文化
en: High-altitude Lake
Floating Islands
Indigenous Culture

zh: 海拔3,812米，世界上海拔最高的可通航湖泊
乌罗斯浮岛：印第安人用芦苇编织的人工岛屿
太阳岛（Isla del Sol）是印加神话的发源地
en: At 3,812 m, the world's highest navigable lake
Uros Floating Islands — handmade reed islands inhabited for centuries
Isla del Sol — birthplace of the Inca sun god in mythology

tips.zh: 普诺（Puno）是游览的最佳出发地。海拔极高，建议在库斯科适应一天后再前往，备好高山病药物。
tips.en: Puno is the best base. Altitude (3,812 m) is significant — spend a day acclimatising in Cusco first and carry altitude sickness medication.

description.zh: 纳斯卡线条是公元1世纪至700年间绘制于纳斯卡沙漠地表的巨型地画，图案包括猴子、蜂鸟、蜘蛛等动物形象，只有从空中才能完整看清，其目的至今仍是未解之谜。
description.en: The Nazca Lines are enormous geoglyphs etched into the desert between 1 AD and 700 AD — monkeys, hummingbirds, spiders — only fully visible from the air. Their purpose remains one of archaeology's great mysteries.

zh: 世界遗产
地画
神秘文化
en: UNESCO
Geoglyphs
Ancient Mystery

zh: 公元1—700年间刻在沙漠地面上的巨型地画，只能从空中辨认
蜂鸟、猴子、宇航员等200余个图形，最大达370米
仍是人类历史之谜，无法解释其目的
en: Geoglyphs etched into desert 1–700 AD, only fully visible from the air
Over 200 figures including a hummingbird, monkey and 'astronaut'; largest 370 m across
Purpose remains one of history's great unsolved mysteries

admission.zh: 飞机观览约130—250美元/人（30分钟航班）

tips.zh: 飞行观览前避免进食，有不少游客因小型飞机颠簸而感到不适。地面瞭望台仅能看到两条地画，不建议作为唯一方式。
tips.en: Avoid eating before the flight — the small planes are bumpy and motion sickness is common. The ground viewpoint tower shows only two lines and is not a substitute for the flight.

description.zh: 秘鲁亚马逊盆地覆盖全国60%的面积，是生物多样性极其丰富的热带雨林地区。马努国家公园被认为是世界上生物多样性最高的保护区之一，生活着超过1,000种鸟类。
description.en: Peru's Amazon Basin covers 60% of the country and is one of Earth's most biodiverse regions. Manu National Park is considered the world's most biodiverse protected area, home to over 1,000 bird species.

zh: 雨林
生物多样性
野生动物
en: Rainforest
Biodiversity
Wildlife

zh: 伊基托斯（Iquitos）是全球最大的无公路连接城市
亚马逊盆地秘鲁段生物多样性极为丰富
马努国家公园是世界生物多样性最密集的保护区之一
en: Iquitos is the world's largest city inaccessible by road
Peru's Amazon basin is among the world's richest in biodiversity
Manu National Park — one of the world's most biodiverse protected areas

admission.zh: 含导游的丛林徒步营地约400—1,500美元/周/人

tips.zh: 只能乘飞机或坐船到达，建议选择信誉良好的生态旅游营地；6—11月（旱季）水位较低，陆上徒步更容易。
tips.en: Accessible only by plane or boat. Choose a reputable eco-lodge. June–November (dry season) means lower water levels and easier land-based exploration.
